declarations.name: AuiScheduler

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name; grids are named "{label}, {period}".

inputs.name: loadEvents
inputs.description: Range data source instead of events (single events overlapping the range, series masters that may occur in it, and their exceptions).

inputs.name: resources
inputs.description: Timeline rows: { id, label, description?, color? }.

inputs.name: views
inputs.description: Views in the switcher. Default: day, week, work week, month, agenda (plus timeline with resources).

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Move and resize events (pointer, keyboard, toolbar).

inputs.name: recurringEditScope
inputs.description: How changes to recurring occurrences apply; ask shows a dialog.

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Working days (work week), working hours (shading), holidays (headers).

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: First day of weeks. Default: the locale's first day of week.

inputs.name: createId
inputs.description: Id of events created from base (exceptions, split series). Default "{id}~{hint}".

inputs.name: renderEvent
inputs.description: Event content (non-interactive).

inputs.name: now
inputs.description: Advanced: fixed current time (tests, demos); disables the per-minute refresh.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

inputs.name: slotDuration
inputs.description: Minutes per slot (time view rows, day timeline columns).

inputs.name: snapDuration
inputs.description: Minutes moves and resizes snap to.

inputs.name: dayStartHour
inputs.description: First hour shown in time views (0-23).

inputs.name: dayEndHour
inputs.description: Last hour shown, exclusive (1-24, after dayStartHour).

inputs.name: scrollToHour
inputs.description: Hour scrolled into view (and focused) when a time view opens.

inputs.name: monthEventLimit
inputs.description: Rows of events per month cell before "+N more".

inputs.name: agendaDays
inputs.description: Days listed by the agenda (1-62).

inputs.name: timelineScale
inputs.description: Timeline columns: slots of a day, days of a week, or days of a month.

inputs.name: requestTimeoutMs
inputs.description: loadEvents timeout.

inputs.name: historyLimit
inputs.description: Undo depth (0 disables undo).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Month and weekday names, dates, numbers, the first day of the week, and messages.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Timezone of the layout, today, slots, and new times.

inputs.name: disambiguation
inputs.description: DST policy for wall-clock times in a gap or overlap (SPEC section 8.5).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Reading direction; Left/Right arrow keys and chevrons follow it.

models.name: events
models.description: Events: { id, title, start: Instant | PlainDate, end (exclusive instant or inclusive last day), timeZone?, recurrence?, seriesId?, originalStart?, resourceId?, color?, location?, description?, readOnly? }.

models.name: date
models.description: A day in the visible period. Default: today in the timezone.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: The user changed the view or period.

outputs.name: slotActivated
outputs.description: The user asked to create an event (Enter on an empty cell, Shift+Enter, a selection, a pointer range, or a double-click).

outputs.name: eventActivated
outputs.description: The user activated an event (click, Enter, Space).

outputs.name: eventChange
outputs.description: Before a change is applied; preventDefault() refuses it.

outputs.name: eventDeleted
outputs.description: Delete or Backspace on an editable event (the application removes it).

outputs.name: loadError
outputs.description: loadEvents failed, timed out, or returned invalid events.

methods.description: Change the period (next and previous emit aui-navigate).

methods.description: Change the period (next and previous emit aui-navigate).

methods.description: Change the period (next and previous emit aui-navigate).

methods.description: Change the period (next and previous emit aui-navigate).

methods.description: Discard cached ranges and reload the visible range.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG grid for every view except the agenda: table role=grid with day or slot gridcells under one roving tab stop; events are buttons inside the cell where they start (APG "cells containing widgets": Enter/F2 in, Escape/F2 out). The agenda is a region with day headings and lists under one roving tab stop. Moves have three equivalent paths (drag, Ctrl/Cmd+X then Ctrl/Cmd+V, toolbar Move / Move here).

limitations: Multi-day timed events appear as one segment per day in time views (not in the all-day row).
All-day and timed events do not convert by dragging between the all-day row and the time grid.
The timeline shows one day (slots), one week, or one month (days); no custom zoom levels.
Month cells show monthEventLimit rows and "+N more" (which opens the day view).
Deleting only emits aui-event-delete; the application removes the event.
No drag and drop from outside the scheduler, no event creation UI (aui-slot-activate asks the application).
Recurrence follows the RRULE subset of @absoluteui/core.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
